name: MAC Mobility | HA - cluster PE-4 (SW-205165 + SW-240242 + SW-240243)
refined_by: /TEST + /HA + /SPIRENT (DNAAS MCP teach_plan + cmd_search-validated + Confluence SoT injected via search-company-knowledge)
refined_summary: All show/clear/process commands re-validated against dnos_cmd_search on YOR_CL_PE-4 (DNOS 26.2.0). Two new scenarios added per Jira: SC06 (SW-240242 NCC switchover with full L/v/B inventory) and SC07 (SW-240243 unknown-unicast stress around restart with traffic-driven relearn measurement and zebra<->fib-manager parity check). All Spirent ACs are now MCP teach_plan-driven via dnos_dnaas_teach_plan. Topology uses the existing star: PE-4 (cluster) hub, RR-SA-2 PW peer (v source), PE-1 EVPN peer (B source). 2026-05-01 KNOWLEDGE INJECTION (search-company-knowledge): incorporated authoritative Confluence ha-overview pageId 6309413252 + ha-policies-and-failover pageId 6309609689 + management-interfaces pageId 6311379016 + Jira SW-204183 EVPN-SI HA test category + bug catalog SW-261978/SW-263202/SW-263553/SW-262603. Key changes: (1) SSH orchestration switched from standby_ncc_mgmt_ip to mgmt0 VIP -- Confluence states standby NCC SSH is REJECTED with redirect msg. (2) ncc_credentials block added with BOTH NCC IPs + IPMI fallback. (3) container_crash_detection block added to every scenario verify (5 mandatory commands). (4) SC03 known-bug-detection for SW-261978 (fibmgrd restart can delete VPLS PW labels + flush mac-table). (5) traffic_loss_matrix updated per SW-204183: EVPN-SI uses BGP GR/LLGR (NOT NSR); MAC table EMPTIES on bgpd/zebra/fibmgrd restart and relearns from dataplane traffic; with LLGR, PWs stay forwarding throughout. (6) Authoritative event names from Confluence applied (NCC_SWITCHOVER_USER Info / NCC_FAILOVER Error distinction; SYSTEM_PROCESS_RESTART_USER Info; *_HA_VIOLATION + *_HELD_DOWN as stop conditions). (7) Standby NCC processes-down-by-design recognized: process_restart_delta queries scoped to active NCC only.

device_requirements.min_failover_budget_rationale: Refinement (/HA): bumped from 1 -> 4. Cluster failover budget is consumed by NCC switchovers AND by escalated process restarts. Worst-case ALL 7 scenarios = SC01 (NCC swo, -1) + SC02..SC05 (4 process restarts, may escalate, -1 each in worst case) + SC06 (NCC swo, -1) + SC07 sweep (3 process restarts back-to-back, may escalate, -3 in worst case). Standalone DNOS budget is typically 4 in 30 min -- starting at <4 means we cannot complete the suite without budget exhaustion mid-run.

inter_scenario_cooldowns.comment: Refinement (/HA): Mandatory cooldowns to avoid budget exhaustion AND to let convergence settle between scenarios.
inter_scenario_cooldowns.between_two_ncc_switchovers_rationale: SC01 and SC06 are both NCC switchovers. Standby NCC needs ~2-3 min to reach standby-up after a switchover. Failover budget bucket also takes ~5 min to start replenishing (~30 min for full reset). 600s = safe minimum to (a) verify standby is back to standby-up, (b) verify budget recovered by 1, (c) avoid back-to-back-switchover edge cases that have triggered NCC redundancy bugs in the field.

ncc_credentials._comment: Refinement (/HA + Confluence management-interfaces SoT 2026-05-01): MUST hold credentials for BOTH NCCs and BOTH access methods. Per Confluence SoT: SSH to standby NCC physical IP is EXPLICITLY REJECTED with redirect message; orchestration MUST use mgmt0 VIP for active-NCC operations and IPMI/console as fallback for standby-NCC access if needed. Both NCCs must be SSH-reachable on mgmt0 (after switchover, mgmt0 follows the new active NCC). IPMI is reachable in all modes (DNOS, GI, Recovery).

rule_orchestrator_must_follow: 1. Open SSH to {mgmt0} for ALL active-NCC orchestration (set/show/request commands).
2. NEVER open SSH to a standby-NCC physical IP for DNOS CLI -- it is rejected.
3. For NCC switchover (SC01, SC06): expect ~60s SSH disconnect during grace period, reconnect to {mgmt0} (now bound to new active NCC).
4. For active-NCC process restart (SC02, SC03, SC05, SC07): expect <30s SSH blip while bgpd/fibmgrd transitions; reconnect to {mgmt0}.
5. For NCP wb_agent restart (SC04): SSH to {mgmt0} stays alive throughout -- datapath restart does NOT affect routing-engine SSH.
6. For standby-NCC liveness check (prereq, post-test verification): use ICMP ping (NOT SSH) to standby physical IP -- it responds even though SSH is rejected.
7. If {mgmt0} becomes unreachable for >120s, fall back to IPMI on the expected new-active NCC.

evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model._comment: Refinement (/HA + SW-204183 SoT 2026-05-01): The QA EVPN-SI HA epic (SW-204183) explicitly states the recovery model: NSF via BGP GR/LLGR (NOT NSR), MAC table EMPTIES on bgpd/zebra/fib-mgr restart, MACs must be relearned from DATAPLANE TRAFFIC, unknown unicast MUST flood until relearn, with LLGR PWs continue forwarding while control plane recovers. This OVERRIDES the FlowSpec-VPN-style 'NSR keeps everything' model used in our pre-2026-05-01 recipe.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model._authority: Jira SW-204183 description + ~/.cursor/ha-reference/known-behaviors.md 'EVPN-SI HA Authoritative Behavior'
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.principle_1_nsf_protocol: EVPN-SI uses BGP Graceful Restart (GR) + Long-Lived Graceful Restart (LLGR), NOT BGP NSR. With LLGR, BGP routes stay LLGR_STALE and forwarding continues during the helper window.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.principle_2_mac_table_empties: After bgpd OR zebra OR fibmgrd restart on the active NCC, the EVPN MAC table EMPTIES (control-plane forgets all MACs). This is EXPECTED behavior, not a bug.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.principle_3_traffic_driven_relearn: MACs MUST be relearned from dataplane traffic (src MAC in incoming frame). Idle services show 0 v MACs until next frame arrives. This is why every scenario MUST have continuous Spirent traffic during the HA event.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.principle_4_unknown_unicast_flood: Until the destination MAC is relearned, frames addressed to that MAC MUST be flooded (unknown-unicast flooding). Verify this fallback works -- absence = blackhole bug.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.principle_5_llgr_keeps_forwarding: show evpn vpls-pw MUST show PWs Installed throughout the event (LLGR holds the forwarding state even while the BGP session reconverges).
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.principle_6_gr_llgr_failure_path: If GR/LLGR helper fails (e.g., RR also crashes), PWs are removed and MACs flushed. Fallback flooding still applies.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.implications_for_traffic_loss_matrix: For SC02 (bgpd restart) the L source MUST stay 0 loss (local AC unaffected by control plane). For v source, expect a brief flood window as PW MACs get relearned (tolerated). For B source, expect re-flood of RT-2 (tolerated up to 1500 frames). For SC03 (fibmgrd restart) similar pattern, but ALSO check for SW-261978 stale-label deletion.
evpn_si_authoritative_recovery_model.implications_for_verify_phases: Each scenario's verify MUST include: (a) PWs were Installed throughout (show evpn vpls-pw with timestamp interleave), (b) MAC table relearned within recovery window, (c) Spirent saw the relearn complete (per-source flow continuity).

traffic_loss_matrix.comment: Refinement (/HA + SW-204183 + Confluence ha-overview SoT 2026-05-01): Per-scenario per-source expected traffic loss anchored to authoritative EVPN-SI HA recovery model. THIS IS A CORRECTION FROM THE ORIGINAL MATRIX -- the prior FlowSpec-VPN-style 'NSR keeps everything = 0 loss on L+v' assumption was WRONG for EVPN-SI. EVPN-SI uses BGP GR/LLGR (NOT NSR), MAC table EMPTIES on bgpd/zebra/fibmgrd restart, MACs MUST be relearned from dataplane traffic, and unknown-unicast MUST flood until relearn. With LLGR, PWs stay forwarding (LLGR_STALE) throughout the helper window. The matrix below reflects this authoritative model.
traffic_loss_matrix.source_authority: Jira SW-204183 EVPN-SI HA test category 6 + Confluence ha-overview pageId 6309413252 + Confluence ha-policies-and-failover pageId 6309609689
traffic_loss_matrix._corrections_log: 2026-05-01: SC01/SC02/SC06 v-source tolerated_loss_frames raised from 0 to 100-200 (MAC table empties + relearn is expected). SC03 same (any loss was previously tagged as bug -- WRONG; only PW label deletion is the bug, frame loss during relearn is expected). SC02 B-source tolerated_loss_frames kept at 1500 (RT-2 re-flood is correct). nsf_promise_held key REPLACED with gr_llgr_helper_window_held + mac_relearn_completed_in_window.
traffic_loss_matrix.verdict_action: FAIL on any per_source loss > expected_max; WARN on loss > expected_typical; DEGRADED_LINK_BUG on PW label deletion (SW-261978) or vMACs not learned (SW-263202) or seq# regression (SW-263553)

SC01_ncc_switchover.ha_event_type: EVPN-SI NCC switchover with BGP GR/LLGR helper window
SC01_ncc_switchover.promise: PWs stay forwarding (LLGR); MAC table empties on new active + traffic-driven relearn; unknown-unicast flood until relearn

L.rationale: Local AC datapath fully holds during S/O; LLGR irrelevant for L source

v.rationale: PW Installed state held by LLGR. MAC table on new active is EMPTY -> first frames flood until src MAC relearned. Brief flood window expected.

B.rationale: EVPN remote MACs flushed locally, RT-2 reapplied via LLGR_STALE then refreshed after BGP reconverges. Brief flood window expected.

SC02_bgpd_restart.ha_event_type: Process restart (bgpd) -- BGP sessions drop+reconverge with GR/LLGR
SC02_bgpd_restart.promise: PWs stay forwarding (LLGR helper window); MAC table empties on the active NCC; MACs relearned from dataplane

L.rationale: Local AC unaffected by bgpd; L MAC source flag is dataplane-driven

v.rationale: VPLS-PW BGP signaling drops, MAC table empties, traffic-driven relearn from PW (SW-204183). Brief flood window expected.

B.rationale: EVPN BGP session drops; RT-2 entries flushed (LLGR helps but B traffic still relearned via dataplane)

SC03_fibmgrd_restart.ha_event_type: Process restart (fibmgrd) -- FIB rebuild + datapath reprogram
SC03_fibmgrd_restart.promise: Per SW-204183 EVPN-SI HA model: MAC table empties + traffic-driven relearn (same as bgpd restart). PW Installed state preserved by LLGR. SW-261978 risk: stale PW labels may be DELETED (DEGRADED_LINK_BUG, not FAIL).

v.rationale: MAC table empties + traffic-driven relearn; brief flood window expected

B.rationale: Same as v -- relearn from dataplane

SC03_fibmgrd_restart._anti_bug_check: If show evpn vpls-pw shows fewer PWs Installed after restart than before = SW-261978 DEGRADED_LINK_BUG

SC04_ncp_wb_agent_restart.ha_event_type: NCP datapath container restart -- TCAM cleared + reprogrammed
SC04_ncp_wb_agent_restart.promise: Datapath restart class -- entire NCP datapath container resets (wb_agent is Non-Restartable); brief traffic impact while TCAM reloads

L.rationale: TCAM cleared -> brief UU flooding window before MAC relearn (~5s @ 50fps = 250 frames typical, 30s outlier = 1500)

v.rationale: Same as L -- PW MACs also need TCAM re-install

B.rationale: Same as L -- EVPN MACs also need TCAM re-install

SC04_ncp_wb_agent_restart._anti_bug_check: If wb_agent core file appears = SW-262603 candidate (FAIL_AND_LINK_BUG); our scale is far below SW-262603's 32K trigger so unlikely at this scale

SC05_restart_during_flap.ha_event_type: Process restart (bgpd) WHILE MACs are actively flapping L<->v -- mobility-suppression interaction
SC05_restart_during_flap.promise: Mobility-suppression must NOT leave any MAC stuck in flag P/F/D after recovery; SW-263553 risk: stale MAC re-promoted with regressed seq#

L.rationale: Some loss during flap window (mobility suppression) + relearn after restart

B.rationale: EVPN BGP re-converges during bgpd restart; B baseline also relearned

SC05_restart_during_flap._anti_bug_check: After recovery, scan show evpn instance {evpn_name} mac-table detail; any MAC with seq# LOWER than pre-test high-water-mark = SW-263553 DEGRADED_LINK_BUG

SC06_ncc_switchover_LvB_inventory.ha_event_type: EVPN-SI NCC switchover with full L+v+B inventory + active traffic (BGP GR/LLGR)
SC06_ncc_switchover_LvB_inventory.promise: PWs stay forwarding (LLGR); MAC table empties on new active + traffic-driven relearn; L source unaffected (datapath holds)

L.rationale: Local AC datapath fully holds; if any L frame lost = local AC datapath failure

v.rationale: PW Installed state held by LLGR; MAC table empty on new active -> brief flood window for src-MAC relearn

B.rationale: RT-2 entries flushed, restored from LLGR_STALE then refreshed; brief flood window for B src-MAC relearn

SC06_ncc_switchover_LvB_inventory._anti_bug_check: If show evpn vpls-pw drops PWs during the helper window = LLGR malfunction (FAIL); if MAC seq# regresses = SW-263553 DEGRADED

SC07_uu_stress_per_iteration.ha_event_type: Per-iteration process restart with 192 MACs under unknown-unicast stress
SC07_uu_stress_per_iteration.promise: Traffic-driven relearn must complete inside expected_max_recovery_seconds; UU flooding fills the gap (per SW-204183)

fibmgrd_restart.rationale: Per SW-204183: MAC table empties + traffic-driven relearn. Brief flood window expected for v/B; L unaffected. SW-261978 anti-bug check applies (PW label deletion).
fibmgrd_restart._anti_bug_check: If show evpn vpls-pw shows fewer PWs Installed = SW-261978 DEGRADED

bgpd_restart._anti_bug_check: If MAC seq# regresses after recovery = SW-263553 DEGRADED

L.rationale: ARP/ND brief impact may show on local AC during MAC relearn

forbidden_flag_transitions.comment: Per-source MAC flag transitions that MUST NEVER occur after recovery. A MAC's source-flag identifies WHERE it was learned (L=local AC, v=VPLS PW, B=EVPN BGP RT-2). Cross-recovery flag swaps indicate critical bugs where the AC absorbed a remote MAC, the PW absorbed a local MAC, etc. Catches SW-194680-class issues (multi-source MAC mobility flag confusion).

rules.label: EVPN-BGP MAC reappeared as Local
rules.explanation: PE-4 ge100-18/0/1 absorbed a MAC that was previously learned via RT-2 from PE-1. Implies bgpd RT-2 withdrawal raced with local AC learn -- breaks split-horizon and steers remote traffic into the wrong AC.

rules.label: VPLS-PW MAC reappeared as Local
rules.explanation: PE-4 ge100-18/0/1 absorbed a MAC that was previously learned over the VPLS PW from RR-SA-2. Implies the PW peer (2.2.2.2) withdrawal raced with local AC learn -- forwarding loop risk.

rules.label: Local MAC reappeared as VPLS-PW
rules.explanation: A MAC that was sourced from PE-4's own AC is now seen as PW-learned. Implies PE-4 broadcasted its own local MAC over PW and the PW echo was accepted -- broken split-horizon-group.

rules.label: Local MAC reappeared as EVPN-BGP
rules.explanation: PE-4's own MAC is now seen as RT-2 from a remote PE. Implies PE-4 advertised its own local MAC and the route was reflected back through the RR -- broken RT-import filtering.

rules.label: VPLS-PW <-> EVPN-BGP swap
rules.explanation: A MAC's transport flag flipped between v and B during recovery. Sometimes legitimate during EVPN/VPLS transition, but persistent swap may indicate sequence-number / mac-mobility-extcom mishandling.
